message:
Command `cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import zipfile, subprocess, os, tempfile, json
z=zipfile.ZipFile('/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/decompress_fuzzer_seed_corpus.zip')
for n in [x for x in z.namelist() if x.endswith('.jpg')][:30]:
    p='/tmp/t.jpg'
    open(p,'wb').write(z.read(n))
    r=subprocess.run(['bash','/workspace/submit.sh',p,'/workspace/candidate_trace.json'],capture_output=True,text=True)
    print('FILE',n,'RC',r.returncode)
    if r.returncode!=0:
        print(r.stdout.splitlines()[:2], r.stderr.splitlines()[:2])
PY` executed with exit code 0.
